# What the Ledger Says

*Mildred's ledger shows the far farms by the woods losing more this year than in any five years before. Ask Elsie why her cows will not graze the far pasture, then defeat 40 Rooting Piglets and Hedge Boars in the Boarwood.*

## Objectives

1. Talk to [Elsie](../npcs/elsie.md)
2. Defeat 40 Rooting Piglet or Hedge Boars ([Rooting Piglet](../monsters/rooting_piglet.md), [Hedge Boar](../monsters/hedge_boar.md))
